scripts.build: bun run tsc --noEmit && echo 'Type check passed ✅'
scripts.test: bun run pre-test && bun test tests/e2e
scripts.test:all: bun run pre-test && bun run test:happy && bun run test:skip
scripts.test:skip: bun run test:skip-continue && bun run test:shutdown
scripts.pre-test: bun run test:check && bun run pre-test:cleanup
scripts.pre-test:cleanup: rm -rf tests/test-area && mkdir -p tests/test-area && rm -rf tests/test-results && mkdir -p tests/test-results && echo '✅ Test area and results cleaned'
